name: observational-memory
description: Compaction as observational memory: in the background, after each turn and during a long one, an Observer (GPT-5.6 Luna through pi) turns each ~10k-token chunk of the conversation (up to four at once), at a size target of about nine lines a chunk, into attributed, prioritized observations, each with the transcript time range it came from, keeping tool errors and the head and tail of long results, and code adds up to five of the assistant's own sentences a chunk that hold a number, path or reason the observations lack; a reply that is incomplete or malformed is never stored, a line without a priority marker continues the one before but never a critical one whose quote is closed (it stands as its own line), each such line logged and counted, and when they grow a Reflector condenses the older ones near its target size, keeping the newest as they were and every critical line word for word, a result far under the target is refused and the same input not sent again, an earlier reflection's lines pass through uncondensed while they fit their tier, and file paths the Reflector drops are put back. Compaction cuts at the observed watermark with no model call, and a context that differs from the history keeps what was observed up to the first row that differs, counting how it differs in the stats; where the Observer has not observed enough, has failed or its memory is over budget, a session brief compiled by code from the unobserved rows (goal, files, commits, outstanding items and a log, each line naming the om_recall block it came from) stands in place of the built-in compaction and fits one total budget for the model's window: it keeps recent messages, with older tool results and inputs cut to their head and tail (the newest whole) and a notice repeated in them shown once, a list of the failures not yet fixed, the assistant's last reply of each turn that left context, the user's messages verbatim, those the corrections quote not repeated (short ones kept whole the longest) (the first one, a crewmate's brief, with its start and its end when it is too long), the user's constraints in force (standing rules only: a one-time approval is an ordinary note and never replaces or relaxes a constraint; a reversal replaces what it names, a repeat is one line, and past their cap the oldest shorten to an index line naming the om_recall query that finds them), one continuation record as a handoff (what is active, completed, blocked or waiting for the user, the next steps, what the user was already told, and the git state read by code), led by a Session line naming the session's overall goal and the role the user gave the assistant, which a small Luna call of its own writes in the background and keeps stable, never on compaction's path, and the instructions given to /compact; a decision waiting for the user stays a question. A standing note in the system prompt tells the model what the memory is and how to resume from it. Skills in use are carried across compactions, and an om_recall tool, kept out of the deferred tool list once a compaction has run and named at the end of the memory as the way to recover any detail the observations lack, searches (ranking lines that hold a searched term whole first), reads and outlines the full transcript, lists the files the session read, edited or wrote, following a session across moved transcript files, skipping replayed and injected text, and saying what it covered and did not; om_stats and /om-stats report usage per session, and sessions untouched for 30 days are pruned from the store, checked again just before each deletion.
